'''Arvind Bhasker''' (also published as '''Arvind Bhaskar'''; DeckTech handle '''Master Chief''')<ref name="dt-23914">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23914 Maul’s Combat], DeckTech (Arvind "Master Chief" Bhasker, 13 June 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/23914/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/23914/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009104323/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23914/ Wayback Machine].</ref> posted a [[Dark]] [[Let Them Make The First Move / At Last We Will Have Revenge|Let Them Make The First Move]] list on DeckTech that went 3–0 in the May World Qualifiers (''Maul’s Combat''). He played the [[2015 Match Play Championship]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2015-match-play-championship/ 2015 Match Play Championship], starwarsccg.org</ref>
